title: Dissecting the effect of ALS mutation S375G on the conformational properties and aggregation dynamics of TDP-43(370-375) fragment.
authors: Xu, Zhengdong; Zhang, Jianxin; Tang, Jiaxing; Gong, Yehong; Zou, Yu; Zhang, Qingwen
one_liner_zh: 该文用全原子MD模拟研究ALS相关TDP-43片段S375G突变对聚集构象的影响，虽涉及蛋白-DNA结合蛋白但非TF-DNA互作体系，且无结合位点或界面建模，仅聚焦蛋白自身聚集，与本课题关联较弱。
abstract: The aggregation of transactive response deoxyribonucleic acid (DNA) binding protein of 43 kDa (TDP-43) into ubiquitin-positive inclusions is closely associated with amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (ALS), frontotemporal lobar degeneration, and chronic traumatic encephalopathy. The 370-375 fragment of TDP-43 ((370)GNNSYS(375), TDP-43(370-375)), the amyloidogenic hexapeptides, can be prone to forming pathogenic amyloid fibrils with the characteristic of steric zippers. Previous experiments reported the ALS-associated mutation, serine 375 substituted by glycine (S375G) is linked to early onset disease and protein aggregation of TDP-43. Based on this, it is necessary to explore the underlying molecular mechanisms. By utilizing all-atom molecular dynamics (MD) simulations of 102 mus in total, we investigated the impact of S375G mutation on the conformational ensembles and oligomerization dynamics of TDP-43(370-375) peptides. Our replica exchange MD simulations show that S375G mutation could promote the unstructured conformation formation and induce peptides to form a loose packed oligomer, thus inhibiting the aggregation of TDP-43(370-375). Further analyses suggest that S375G mutation displays a reduction effect on the number of total hydrogen bonds and contacts among TDP-43(370-375) peptides. Hydrogen bonding and polar interactions among TDP-43(370-375) peptides, as well as Y374-Y374 pi-pi stacking interaction, are attenuated by S375G mutation. Additional microsecond MD simulations demonstrate that S375G mutation could prohibit the conformational conversion to beta-structure-rich aggregates and possess an inhibitory effect on the oligomerization dynamics of TDP-43(370-375). This study offers for the first time of molecular insights into the S375G mutation affecting the aggregation of TDP-43(370-375) at the atomic level, and may open new avenues in the development of future site-specific mutation therapeutics.
abstract_zh: 反式激活反应脱氧核糖核酸（DNA）结合蛋白43 kDa（TDP-43）聚集成泛素阳性包涵体与肌萎缩侧索硬化症（ALS）、额颞叶变性及慢性创伤性脑病密切相关。TDP-43的370-375片段（(370)GNNSYS(375)，TDP-43(370-375)），即淀粉样六肽，易于形成具有立体拉链特征致病性淀粉样纤维。先前实验报道，与ALS相关的突变，即丝氨酸375被甘氨酸取代（S375G），与早发性疾病及TDP-43蛋白聚集相关。基于此，有必要探索其潜在分子机制。通过利用总时长为102微秒的全原子分子动力学（MD）模拟，我们研究了S375G突变对TDP-43(370-375)肽构象系综及寡聚化动力学的影响。我们的副本交换MD模拟显示，S375G突变可促进无序构象形成，并诱导肽形成松散堆积的寡聚体，从而抑制TDP-43(370-375)的聚集。进一步分析表明，S375G突变对TDP-43(370-375)肽间总氢键数量及接触具有减少效应。TDP-43(370-375)肽间的氢键和极性相互作用，以及Y374-Y374的π-π堆积相互作用，均因S375G突变而减弱。额外的微秒级MD模拟证明，S375G突变可阻止向富含β-结构聚集体的构象转换，并对TDP-43(370-375)的寡聚化动力学具有抑制作用。本研究首次在原子水平上提供了S375G突变影响TDP-43(370-375)聚集的分子见解，并可能为未来位点特异性突变疗法的开发开辟新途径。
